# U-SPCC-29 — Derived artefacts regenerated by their own generators

## 1. Cause

Four reds, one cause: the derived artefacts predated
`experiments/ptr-engine/measure/rows-spcc-billedproof-2026-11-10.jsonl`
(100 rows, arm `masking-no-fetch`, the billed-token proof run). Three of the
four failed with the literal message `rows file missing from corpus:
rows-spcc-billedproof-2026-11-10.jsonl`, emitted by
`validate_report()` in `experiments/ptr-engine/longrun/tests/test_verbosity.py:700`
against the on-disk `rows-*.jsonl` set (`:697`). The fourth,
`test_stop_reason.py::OnDiskArtefact::test_stop_reason_json_matches_a_fresh_scan`,
failed the same way through the `--check` path of
`experiments/ptr-engine/tools/stop_reason_audit.py`.

No code or test defect. The rows file is correct and append-only; only the
JSON/MD derived tables were stale.

## 2. Repair — the generators named by the artefacts themselves

Neither artefact was hand-edited. Both were rewritten by the tool that owns them.

- **STOP-REASON.json** — `experiments/ptr-engine/tools/stop_reason_audit.py`,
  invoked with no arguments (default mode scans `measure/` for `ROWS_GLOB`
  and writes the single artefact; module docstring line 51). Result:
  `rows 7969, answered 6665, empty 1304, empty-with-tokens 1286,
  reasoning-with-empty-content 1114`, causes
  `{"no_answer_text_field": 31, "unrecorded_empty_content": 1261,
  "zero_tokens_no_content": 12}`.
- **VERBOSITY.json + docs/VERBOSITY.md** — the builder in
  `experiments/ptr-engine/longrun/tests/test_verbosity.py`, invoked as a
  script (`build()` → `write=True`, `:322-341`, `__main__` at `:845`). It
  rebuilds `corpus`, `cells`, `small_cells`, `fits`, `decomposition`,
  `verdict` from `glob(measure/rows-*.jsonl)` and rewrites the MD. Result:
  `cells=109 p95_ok=33 refused=73 decomp=23 fits=85`,
  `VERDICT confound_immaterial` (focus pair `pointer-stable` /
  `transcript-grow`, 86.7% of the TTFT gap survives completion-length
  normalisation), `VALIDATE_ERRORS []`.

There is no separate corpus manifest/sha list to rebuild: the sha256 per
rows file and `rows_total` are recomputed inside `build()`, and
`test_every_rows_file_appears_with_its_sha` (`:777`) asserts that the corpus
set equals the on-disk `rows-*.jsonl` set. Regenerating the two artefacts
*is* the index rebuild.

## 3. Why the verdict did not move

The new file contributes one arm (`masking-no-fetch`) in its own cell; the
verdict focus pair is still the `rows-longrun-c-2026-10-26.jsonl`
`pointer-stable`/`transcript-grow` pair. The regeneration is additive:
`VERBOSITY.json` +118/−0 lines, `STOP-REASON.json` +39/−6, `docs/VERBOSITY.md`
+6/−6 (counts shifted, verdict text unchanged). No expectation was edited.

## 4. Proof

`23 passed in 1.08s` for the two files under pytest; `grep -c` finds the new
rows file 4× in `VERBOSITY.json`, 2× in `STOP-REASON.json`, 4× in
`docs/VERBOSITY.md`; `tools/doc_check.py` exits 0.

## 5. Not touched

`measure/rows-*.jsonl` (append-only), `run_longrun.py`, `score_longrun.py`,
all preview files, both test files.
